description: Angular component for notification type filtering panel, managing selection, filtering, and UI interactions for notification types.

classes.name: NotificationTypeFilterPanelComponent
classes.description: Angular component for filtering notification types with search and selection features.

methods.name: ngOnInit
methods.description: Initializes filtered notification types list with debounce and filter logic.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates the parent component with selected notification types and disposes overlay.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Clears all selected notification types and updates form control validity.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes a notification type from the selected list.

methods.name: onFocus
methods.description: Handles focus event, updates form control if dirty.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds a notification type to the selected list.

methods.name: chipAdd
methods.description: Handles adding a notification type via chip input event.

methods.name: displayTypeFn
methods.description: Returns display string for a notification type.
